parsed.post: Significant improvement! Increasing DEPTH from 4 to 8 reduced val_bpb from 1.1078 to 1.0357. Capacity seems to be a key driver here. Next, I'll try to optimize the learning rate and weight decay to further refine this deeper architecture.
parsed.description: Keep the increased depth (8) and test a slightly lower learning rate with non-zero weight decay to prevent overfitting in the larger model.
